name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips or at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until they are vertical.
Lower slowly until your feet hover above the floor.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A lying leg raise that trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
